notes.title: Single Player AI tank fix + Co-op difficulty improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]AI Command tanks now properly target Player tanks in Single Player and Co-op game modes.
[*]Co-op has additional difficulty scaling to match the player count of a Co-op game.
[/list]
